name: Cologne Cathedral
description: Landmark Gothic cathedral with a huge facade, plus guided tours & Rhine views.

name: Time Ride
description: Unique, historical virtual reality experience of Cologne's Old Town in the replica of a tram.

name: Museum Ludwig
description: The formerly private collection of Peter Ludwig, with paintings, ceramics, sketches & prints.

name: Schnütgen Museum
description: Noted collection of Medieval religious art & sculpture housed in an elegant Romanesque church.

name: Rheingarten
description: This strip of parkland along the Rhine River has walking & cycling paths.

name: Old Market
description: Historic town square with a variety of shops, restaurants & bars, plus a famous Christmas market.

name: Kolumba
description: Modern & classic Christian artworks in contemporary spaces amid 19th-century church remains.

name: Shrine of the Three Kings
description: Elaborate, gilded reliquary in Cologne cathedral said to contain the bones of the biblical magi.

name: Hahnen Gate
description: Restored 13th-century gate that was part of the city wall featuring towers & Cologne's coat of arms.

name: Flora und Botanischer Garten Köln
description: Garden with 11.5 hectares of plants from all climatic zones, plus spring blooms & greenhouses.

name: Equestrian Statue of Kaiser Wilhelm II
Heinzelmännchenbrunnen
description: Ornate 19th-century fountain & sculptures commemorating a local legend about house gnomes.

name: Old St. Alban
description: Ruins of an medieval Romanesque church & monuments heavily damaged in World War II.

name: Ulrepforte
description: 13th-century stone watchtower & gate in the former city walls, open for guided tours.

name: Equestrian monument to King Frederick William III of Prussia
Eigelsteintorburg
description: Event space for private hire at turreted medieval town gates for concerts, seminars & exhibitions.

name: Fort X
description: Ancient remains of a stone fortress featuring a landscaped rose garden & kids' play areas.

name: Dom Treasury
description: Relics, vestments & liturgical items housed in the subterranean vaults of Cologne Cathedral.

name: Ristorante il Tartufo
description: Upscale Italian mains, pasta & pizza offered in a light-filled restaurant with a wood-fired oven.

name: Gruber's
description: Classic & creative dishes with Austrian wines in an upscale dining room with a romantic terrace.

name: Bei Oma Kleinmann
description: Long-established, lively venue with outdoor tables, serving schnitzels with sauces & beers.

name: Kuchi Mami
description: Unfussy Asian restaurant serving curries, noodles & meat dishes, plus nigiri, sashimi & sushi rolls.

name: Max Stark
description: Informal brewpub with a homey, vintage interior serving traditional fare, beer & other drinks.

name: Restaurant Brücken
description: Mediterranean seafood & classic meaty German dishes at an unassuming eatery with sidewalk tables.

name: Gaffel am Dom - Brauhaus
description: Traditional eatery offering regional dishes, a brewhouse & a garden terrace, plus live music.

name: Hänneschen und die Pfeffermühle
description: Cozy eatery adjoining a puppet theater, offering hearty international plates in a warm environment.

name: Excelsior Hotel Ernst
description: Grand hotel offering elegant rooms & suites, plus an acclaimed restaurant, a piano bar & a spa.

name: Ruby Ella Hotel Cologne by IHG
description: Contemporary rooms in a hip hotel featuring a 24-hour bar, as well as breakfast & limited parking.

name: SAVOY Hotel
description: Luxe rooms & suites with free Wi-Fi, plus an upscale restaurant, a sleek lounge & a rooftop terrace.

name: Althoff Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg
description: Chic quarters in a lavish hotel set in an 18th-century hunting lodge, offering fine dining & a spa.

name: art'otel Cologne
description: Design-focused hotel offering modern rooms with free Wi-Fi, plus a stylish bar & a restaurant.

name: Steigenberger Hotel Köln
description: Polished property offering an international restaurant, a cozy bar & cathedral views.

name: Hiroshima-Nagasaki-Park
description: Popular hangout spot with a small beer garden & kiosk providing refreshments to visitors.

name: Rheinpark
description: Large landscaped park on both banks of the Rhine, with fountains, playgrounds, a cableway & tours.

name: Friedenspark
description: Small urban park for recreation featuring a historic fort & an WWI monument with an eagle statue.

name: Erholungsgebiet Leidenhausen
description: Picturesque natural area with boars & other wildlife, plus a playground, trails & a restaurant.

name: Stadtwald
description: City forest established in 1895 with trails, meadows, 2 ponds & a petting zoo with farm animals.

name: Rheinaue Langel-Merkenich
description: Pebble beach & quiet, grassy trail overlooking the Rhine River & Cologne's city skyline.

name: Innerer Grüngürtel
description: Sprawling park in the city center featuring grassy fields with trails, play equipment & a pond.

name: Wildlife park Dünnwald
description: Scenic wooded wildlife park with free-roaming animals, feed dispensers & walking paths.

name: Dellbrücker Heide
description: Wooded paths, heather fields & a lake in a protected area with small species & birds.

name: Forstbotanischer Garten und Friedenswald
description: Botanical gardens with trees & shrubs from around the world including giant redwood & rhododendrons.
